_doc: Mary-O's own half of `asset editor-art`: the nouns this game invented, and
the engine art they should wear in the LDtk editor. Everything shared with
the rest of Ambition (Solid, OneWayPlatform, PickupSpawn, the IntGrid
values) is mapped by the tool itself — this file only says what the tool
A bare name is an engine entity sprite (assets/sprites/entities/<name>.png);
anything with a slash is a path under the sprite folder. Re-run after
_field_art_doc: Art that follows a FIELD, per placed instance. The field must be an Enum
in mary_o.entities.json — LDtk can only vary an entity's tile by an enum
value — and each value here names what that value looks like.
This is the same split the game makes: `kind` decides the look and
`contents` decides the payout, so a Brick holding a quasar looks like
masonry in the editor exactly as it does in play.
